collection.description: An old custom sends flowers and carved objects into the river, where debris is accumulating.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An old custom sends flowers and carved objects into the river, where debris is accumulating.

choices.label: Use fallen leaves that decay naturally.
Keep offerings on a dry altar.
Stop the practice and explain why.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The ceremony unites villagers, but debris gathers downstream.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A flood carries the offerings away, raising new concerns.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The river stays clearer, and the ritual continues.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder worries that the change loses meaning.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The river is protected, and the shrine gains a new tradition.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some worshippers miss the river ceremony.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The water clears, though arguments persist.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Families invent private ways to remember loved ones.
